scientific_integrity: All universal statements rely on a complete elementary proof; finite computations cross-checked critical spectral, flux and transient identities. The literature comparison distinguishes established general generator formulas from the new rate-dependent classification. No independent audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Ideal three-state continuous-time master equation with one tunable reverse edge; two of the forward transitions have no reverse reactions.
Exact population oscillations are damped rather than self-sustained; the coherence ratio is a spectral proxy.
No noisy-observation, general multistate-network, or thermodynamically consistent fully reversible extension is proved.
Potential direct historical coverage in inaccessible full texts of Qian (2006) or Presse et al. (2010) is not excluded.
title: Reentrant stochastic oscillations under a backward kinetic transition
